reviews.text: I’ve been going here for a few years now but had to write a glowing review for Dr. Burg! She is such a knowledgeable vet who takes the time to read my cat’s chart and listen to my concerns before offering solutions that fit my budget and lifestyle. I appreciate how she clearly explains all the risks and benefits and it feels like we really come up with a plan together. I feel like my cat is in such great hands every time we go to see her!

Pure Paws will always, always, always be my vet. Every single person there treats you with such care. I am a very anxious dog Mom and they are always so kind and patient with all my questions and nerves. They never upsell or overcharge and you always know exactly what you're going to pay for before services are done. I love Pure Paws so much!
Barbie, thank you! We truly appreciate your support and are glad to have you as part of our Pure Paws Veterinary Care of Clinton Hill family.
my dog hates the vet, but this is the best care we’ve gotten - they are always kind and thoughtful and prompt. i’m grateful for purepaws!
The team here are amazing. They are always patient and kind with my dog Maurice who can be a tricky customer.
Love everyone here highly recommend

Good doctors, but impossible to get ahold of anybody by phone. First on hold for 25 minutes then disconnected, then left two voicemails over next hour but received no callbacks, then they closed for the day.
Amazing staff and super knowledgeable

I trust every single staff member at this practice. I’ve been here 5-6 times in the past year and have never had a bad experience. Any questions/concerns/problems, they’ll have a solution. Some might say their prices are high and maybe that’s true but just let the vet know your budget and they’ll make something work. I’ve been directed to order numerous meds on chewy instead of thru them since it’s cheaper and I don’t even ask, they automatically give me that option. I know my sweet kitty is in good hands each time. Highly recommend

We love the positive and happy energy at Pure Paws. The vets are wonderfully informative, and the vet tech who handles our dog, Elliot, is so loving. Our dog is large and the tech gets on the ground and gives him hearty belly rubs...which Elliot really enjoys!

Ld, we’re so glad to know you had a wonderful experience at Pure Paws Veterinary Care of Clinton Hill! Our team is dedicated to giving every pet the best care possible, and it means a lot to see that reflected in your review. Thank you for your support!
Pure paws is the right place to bring your pet! Always great service and Dr. Liff is the best!

We've been taking our pets here since it was Brooklyn Cares! We generally have an abundance of pets & the doctors & techs here have always been caring, helpful & Informed. We trust them implicitly with our current 5 cats just like we have with cats & dogs who have crossed the rainbow bridge. We love Pure Paws!

Pure Paws has been taking care of my dog, who's now a senior, for almost a decade. I always had a great experience with the staff and really appreciate the quality of care they offer to their patients. Doctors always have the best interest of the animals in mind. Whether it's preventative care, emerging issues, dental cleaning or a simple wellness exam, I know that my dog is in skillful hands.
Hi Se, Thank you for the positive review! Our team sincerely appreciates it!

Arianna, thank you so much for your positive review! We strive to provide top-notch care for all our furry patients.
Sonia, thank you so much for review! We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!
Speedy, easy, friendly
Clean office nice staff. Very helpful with what I needed for my pup.
Natalie, thank you! We truly appreciate your support and are glad to have you as part of our Pure Paws Veterinary Care of Clinton Hill family.

I tried this vet out and wanted to love it, but unfortunately, when my final amount was higher than expected, I reviewed the bill and found that I had been double-charged for multiple items. The double charges were different amounts for the same item ($29 and $49 for Gabapentin, for example), which made me not trust the billing process at all. The vet heavily pushed sales over giving genuine advice.
Wonderful

When looking for a new vet we were on the search for a clinic that not only understood and cared for our dog but made our experience  at the vet feel painless. Pure paws did exactly that! Dr. Slome and her team were so kind and thoughtful. Great first experience!!!
Always have a great experience at Pure Paws Clinton Hill. They’re very friendly with my dog and make him feel comfortable.

My Shih tzu Mr. Lucky was due for his annual shots and exam. After four years in Marine Park and a couple of visits to Bed-stuy, I  decided to try PurePaws Vet Care. I am so glad that I did. Dr Torre and her staff gave him a thorough and complete exam. They were very attentive and gave good tips and insights to address his issues. I was grateful to see that they don't upsell and add  fees to their invoices. They give an exact amount you pay. Which is why you want to trust PurePaws with your pets health and your purse.

Prandai, we’re so glad to know you had a wonderful experience at Pure Paws Veterinary Care of Clinton Hill! Our team is dedicated to giving every pet the best care possible, and it means a lot to see that reflected in your review. Thank you for your support!
Friendly staff and knowledgeable Doctors
kind, caring, and professional.

The staff is excellent in terms of replying to phone calls in a timely manner and setting up appointments.  They were very sympathetic to the fact that my cat would not cooperate with getting into his carrier, and we missed the appointment.  However, they were able to fit us in another slot expediently.

The triage specialist were so thoughtful and caring, especially Rosa, whom my cat allowed to pick him up.  He never even allows me to do that, but he was all nuzzled up in her bosom as though he were a newborn baby.

The Doctors, especially Dr. Slome, are all just amazing.  Dr. Slome is compassionate and just all around wonderful!  She took very good care of my cat, and now he is all better.

I highly recommend Pure Paws, for all of your veterinary needs!

Pure Paws level of service, compassion, and professionalism are the things that all people who are involved in health care for our 4 legged companions, and ourselves, should strive for.

They are truly animal lovers!  I highly recommend Pure Paws for your veterinary care.
Hello Anthony, Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
Hi Lark, Thank you for the positive review! Our team sincerely appreciates it!
Been taking my pup here for years. Amazing staff, great Vets, super helpful and kind to our girl. Couldn't recommend more!

I've used Pure Paws for 4 years with my cat and can always count on them being honest and compassionate. Whether it's a physical, dental extraction, or a nail infection, I know Smidge and I are in good hands.

The staff and the Veterinarian were very professional, easy going, friendly, and kind. The showed great interest in my dog and made sure they did everything that was possible to make sure Ares would soon get well. Everything the vet did was explained to me and that felt really comfortable.  I also received a follow up call the next morning.
Hello Sam, your support means a lot — thank you for the positive review!

I’ve been coming here for years now and have recommended Pure Paws to everyone I know with a pet. A few friends have made the switch, and all who have are glad they did! Appointments are easy to book, the techs and vets answer all of your questions, and it feels like they really care about you as a client! They prioritize your pets’ safety and comfort and the prices feel fair for most services— often significantly less than other vets in the area.

I’ll be coming here as long as I have pets and live in Brooklyn. Would highly, highly recommend to anyone, especially if you’ve had bad experiences with other vets and are ready for a place where you and your pet feel valued and cared for!

Clinton hill is a hard NO for me I called there only to be redirected to another place I hung up and called HELLS KITCHEN AND GOT WHAT I NEEDED.

I go to Hell’s Kitchen they are phenomenal Brooklyn not their office is a dirty environment and nasty attitudes moving forward my ex agreed to Hell’s Kitchen he was unhappy with bklyn services on top of that with a very hefty vet bill they insisted on a quarter he didn’t have and they could not provide change 🤷🏽‍♀️🤦🏽‍♀️ of a dollar he had to go get change of a dollar for a quarter on a 500 dollar bill a quarter!

I have been a client of Pure Paws (formerly Brooklyn Cares) since it opened in the early Aughts. They have cared for three of my cats (two whom have since passed away, one humanely at their offices and the other assisted at home). I moved out of the neighborhood in 2019 but keep returning because their vets and vet techs are both knowledgeable and caring. They are transparent about services and costs, and do not try to upsell. Hello Graciela, thank you for the positive review — we’re glad to have your support!
Professional, and they treat animals with love and respect 😍🐱 …

The welcome sign was bleutiful to see. Small things can count the most. The place is always clean, the staff are all welcoming and knowledgeable.  I've been visiting for 4 years and the service has remained great. Thank you for taking Greta care of my Baby Blue.

Another terrific experience at Pure Paws. Dr Liz Burg was friendly, knowledgeable and helpful as usual, and put our minds at ease. We have been bringing our Cats to Pure Paws of Clinton Hill for well over a decade now, and will continue to do so.
Shanice, thank you so much for review! We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!

Lost track of how many years I’ve been bringing my girl Kora to Pure Paws. Always a good experience. Value their care and appreciate the quick follow up with test results, prescription refills and replies to questions.

My baby Humbert (19 yo, cat) has a great Vet Dr. Burg.  She prescribed medicine for him to calm his nerves for his visit.  It’s important for me to see that she cared about his mental health .  Dr. Burg is communicative and receptive in answering my questions and concerns.  Also, when I call in to reschedule an appointment, ask questions or leave a message for the doctor they’ve always been polite and courteous, as well as the front desk personnel.

I will never have anything bad to say about Pure Paws Clinton Hill. If I ever have a bad experience here it will be because they caught ME slipping.

The front desk people are extremely professional, patient, and nice. The waiting room is clean and comfortable. The vet techs are super helpful. All of the doctors I’ve worked with have been amazing and really took the time to answer my questions and help me.

They are amazing at providing you will all the resources you could need, and even share with you the cost breakdown of everything they’re going to do so that you can approve it, and then you’re not shocked by the bill at the end.

Needless to say, I will be taking my dog here for as long as we live in the city. And if I ever move away from the area, you bet I’ll be making the trek over to make sure my baby keeps receiving the top quality care she gets here.
they are a little expensive but the service is amazing

Happy to have found Dr. Slome and Pure Paws! Everyone I've come into contact with there has been so kind, thorough, and and loving of all the animals that come in and out. Seeing that care in place prior to my kitten's spay procedure gave me much needed peace of mind during the day of the procedure itself! Feels good to have a friendly, neighborhood staff of familiar faces that'll be there for my cat in her years to come <3

They did a great job with my kitty Bigwig. I was a few minutes early and went in right away, only waited a couple of minutes. I only allowed specific services to limit the bill from unnecessary charges.
Kelly, thank you! We truly appreciate your support and are glad to have you as part of our Pure Paws Veterinary Care of Clinton Hill family.
They are wonderful and our dog loves them! They're extremely easy to get ahold of and extremely responsive to any followup questions. Very unlike a private equity owned vet in the neighborhood...
A bit on the expensive side but very helpful and friendly and informative
Vets seem very good. Diagnosed my dog's cancer, and prescribed medication that's extended his life a year or so.

I am very grateful to the staff and Dr Mulbach at this veterinary care office/clinic. They respond to both you and your pet's needs with  compassion, urgency (when necessary) and great support. I'm grateful that they are located so close to me, and for their responsiveness to my pet's condition. Its obvious when visiting that they are providing excellent care to pets and their owners.

I truly can’t find the right words. Dr. Muhlbach and her team went above and beyond for my cat when I brought her in for respiratory distress. They did everything they possibly could to save her, and then went above and beyond to double check there were no other underlying issues. They literally saved my cats life and I could not be more grateful. They also made sure I was okay during the whole ordeal! Could not recommend this place enough.

Betty, we’re so glad to know you had a wonderful experience at Pure Paws Veterinary Care of Clinton Hill! Our team is dedicated to giving every pet the best care possible, and it means a lot to see that reflected in your review. Thank you for your support!

I want to start by saying that I do really feel good about bringing my pet here. Henry is my second dog, my first pup Monster was also brought here until his passing in 2020. One thing I appreciate is their break down of prices. The staff is lovely and the doctors are great but as of recently I have felt, I guess the best term is shame?  I couldn't afford the full testing on one visit when I went in to get Henrys vaccinations updated as I do every year. I sort of mentioned my budget knowing well enough that it could go over when the Nurse was like "Well this test is already $140 so I guess that is your budget" it sort of took me by surprise. I ended up finding a better option through petsmart so I did that instead. I would have scheduled it later but I felt guilty that I couldn't pay for it right then and there. About a month later I had taken my pup in for a follow up with the vet after he contracted a UTI. I admit I was tired. I had been working long/late evenings and I was loopy when the same nurse brought me his antibiotics and I asked if it was once a day or twice a day she rolled her eyes and aggressively pointed at the EVERY 12 HOURS on his medication. I apologized and she rolled her eyes again and walked away. I love this vet. I love my pets but I just feel that now I have to have a bit thicker skin in case this particular nurse thinks I'm an idiot.
Hello Saki, Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
Very nice front desk, easy to make an appt, vet and vet tech were super helpful and kind. Didnt feel rushed.

This is a great vet. They call ahead of time about pricing, everyone’s friendly, and they called us the day after we had to bring our dog Lavender to the vet hospital to see how we were doing. There are vets closer to our apartment but we’ll keep coming back to Pure Paws. Thanks so much for taking care of us!

Staff( doctors,techs, reception and others) are caring and compassionate to animals and their humans. They helped to calm my fears and let me be with my fur baby while he was being treated. Thank you. I can't recommend them enough!!

I can’t say enough good things about this office. The staff are so kind, so helpful and knowledgable. If you live in the area (ESPECIALLY if you’re a first-time pet owner) id highly recommend Pure Paws on Fulton!

Pure Paws were very friendly and knowledgeable. My kitties relaxed with Dr. Torre Muhlbach and Rose because they understood that they were animal lovers.

The care and compassion shown by this veterinary team meant everything to me. They treated my pet with such kindness and took the time to explain everything with patience and respect. I’m truly grateful for their professionalism and heartfelt consideration.
The vet was friendly and followed up immediately on my questions.

I brought my senior cat in for a routine checkup that uncovered a serious illness, and ultimately meant he had to be put to sleep. The staff at Pure Paws and Dr. Muhlbach were so kind, communicative, and supportive during this heartbreaking whirlwind of events. They emailed to check in on my little guy after hours and on weekends, and were always quick to respond if I had questions. Dr. Muhlbach always gave me a rough estimate of costs before I consented to procedures, including estimates for urgent care at other facilities. Even when just waiting during busy office hours, the front staff did their best to check in with folks and keep things moving. When I had to make the difficult decision put my cat down, they were truly so patient and kind throughout the process. It was a really difficult time that they made a lot easier. If I get another pet in the future, I will definitely be bringing them here.
Zoolyn, thank you so much for your positive review! We strive to provide top-notch care for all our furry patients.
Dawud, thank you so much for review! We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!
great 1st visit for Basie and me!

We used Pure Paws to help us prepare passports for our cat and dog for an international move to France, and they were absolutely incredible. Super transparent about the process and fees, which were definitely competitive, and willing to go the extra mile. Our dog can be reactive at the vet with new devices she's not familiar with, and they were so nice and gentle, offering her lots of treats to get her comfortable. We 10 out of 10 recommend them.

I have been taking my Chihuahua to Pure Pets for five years. My dog is a rescue and pure paws made him feel at ease, since the first day I started taking him  and that makes me feel at ease, as a pet parent 🐾 …

Amazing and empathetic staff who love and take care of every pet there. My pup hates going to the doctor (who doesn’t) , but he’s comfortable and happy once he’s in their hands. 10/10 would recommend to anyone looking for a vet in Brooklyn.

1. The appointment began on time.

They've been my vet for the past 11 Years or so.
Very knowledgeable, compassionate doctors, they're also very transparent with the costs for all tests and procedures and do a good job of explaining in detail what each line item is before making a decision on what to proceed with.

I did not have a great experience here - the doctor I saw, Dr. Accimé, was rushed, borderline rude and treated my cat like a piece of meat. I had brought my young cat in for a routine check up and the first words out of the doctor's mouth upon examining my cat were "already I see a problem." She then proceeded to tell me my cat likely had a condition that would require a full mouth of tooth extractions and the clinic then proceeded to quote me an exorbitant $7500. I sought a second opinion elsewhere and paid a small fraction of this cost for treatment of what ended up being typical feline gingivitis. This may not be everyone's experience here as I had heard good things about this place but the diagnosis offered was incorrect and the price I was quoted felt a money grab.
This vet center is very warm and welcoming. I love bringing my furbaby here.

In office working very professional and friendly people, start with front desk. I have a very timid dog, but the doctor and his assistant managed to find a way to handle her.
Thank you

Amazing veterinary practice!

Always a great experience here especially with Dr Riley,Dr Berg, and Beverly.

I've been using Pure Paws for over 15 years to care for my med/large dogs and had mostly good experiences so far.  Scheduling is easy, staff provides follow up calls to check on their patients, DVMs are unhurried and thorough during visits. We particularly liked Charles, Leah Reilly, and in the most recent visit Foltin.  The front staff is efficient and latest group of vet techs have been pretty gentle and attentive.

My only complaint from 1-2 years ago is that I cannot be with my dog getting while getting care.  My senior rescue who was very sweet but anxious and fearful from her past experiences with prior owners had her BP taken.  Her BP was concerningly elevated.  The vet tech recommended I come back to retake it but that solution didn't make sense to me.  My dog was exhibiting anxiety when she was dragged to the back (whale-eyed, claws dug in, trying to pancake).  They wouldn't allow me to be present to calm or distract her for her BP reading. I thought that interaction could have been managed differently. That was an isolated incident but I hope there can be more flexibility in the future for fearful, older dogs.

My five year old cane corso (Kane) has been cared for my Pure Paws since the day I received him at ten weeks. I wouldn’t take him anywhere else. They have always gone beyond my expectations in care. At 63 years old, I’ve had 5 dogs. This is the first dog I’ve had that loves to go to the vet. I believe it’s the experience, curiosity, and care provided by Pure Paws.
Great staff and kind vet techs! My dog is a nervous guy, but grows more confident with each visit knowing there's cheese whiz to be had in the exam room.
Dr.Burke was awesome she answered all my questions.Niko will definitely be back!

I brought my cat in with an urgent issue, his toenail had split down the nail bed and he was bleeding, and I was really worried. I hadn’t found a vet in the city yet and was especially nervous going in, but Dr. Burg was able to see us quickly and was calm, reassuring, and so gentle with him. She explained what was happening and that he would need a procedure with sedation, which would normally be very stressful, but she made the entire experience feel manageable and routine. She gave us thorough instructions on post-procedure care and our cat healed perfectly, and I’m incredibly grateful for her care. I’ll definitely be taking all my pets to Dr. Burg going forward, I couldn’t recommend her more.
Pleasant and respectful.
Excellent care. Respectful staff....

Wonderful friendly staff! They are so helpful and amazing that I had to add to this review! Fiona loves going to the vet which is crazy! A dog loving the vet!? Well my Fi does! Thank you guys wow amazing work!
Hello P, thank you for the positive review — we’re glad to have your support!
The staff and vets here are so kind and helpful. Would absolutely recommend!
I love everyone here but especially Dr. Burg!! She’s kind, informative, super knowledgeable and is patient even though I can be a bit nervous sometimes.
Dr Burg is great. Takes her time. Really listens and understands. Is very gentle and compassionate when working with dogs.
Just the best - love the whole staff. They do great work, run on time, and are so kind.

Generally competent & thorough as far as care is concerned, though did not appreciate having an extra charge sprung on me after having already spent over $1,000 on exam & various tests for my large dog. At end of exam session, was handed vials for fecal & urine samples, told to obtain & return asap.  I assumed tests for these samples was included in the tests I just paid for ... but upon returning the fecal sample, was told it would cost me an extra $96 (while, oddly, the urine sample was, in fact, included as part of the tests I already paid for).  This really ticked me off.  I think it was reasonable to assume all necessary tests would have been part of the original charge, and if they were not, I should have been told clearly I would have an additional charge.  I was not prepared to dish out an extra $96 and opted not to submit the fecal sample. This is a great example of why people are so critical of vets, the hidden charges (assuming you'll just cave to them), the lack of clarity, it's not consumer-friendly.  Deciding whether to stick with them ....

We love Pure Paws Vets in Clinton Hill! All the staff are so caring and they take such good care of Ruby. They are very punctual for appointments and very responsive via email and phone. They make us feel very safe having our pup in their care. Thank you!
My cat has been coming here for every service, we are treated very respectfully, always with care as if my pet is their own. Wide variety of services and many options as far as payments

took my cat here for a checkup with a couple specific concerns.  All the staff were very pleasant, dr burg had great bedside manner and was very knowledagble.  She addressed my concerns and we also decided to do some general bloodwork tests.

I liked how upfront she was about the pricing -- she walked me through everything and we decided what made sense to do and what made sense to skip.  It wasn't cheap but wasn't really any more expensive than any other NYC based vet I've been to.  At other vets there has generally been no mention of the price until you get hit with a fat bill at the end.  Obviously I know what I'm getting into with this sort of veterinary care so it doesn't really "change" anything, but it was nice being treated with the understanding that yes, this stuff is expensive rather than sort of trying to hide it until it comes time to pay, idk.

I had a couple follow up questions a few weeks later and she replied via email quickly and informatively.
These folks are great. They have been super patient with our VERY vet-reactive dog. They call with reminders to set up routine appointments and we get test results promptly.

Failed to recognize a kitten had FIP as shown in bloodwork. Even ChatGPT could diagnose better, and did,  after the fact unfortunately. The bloodwork was classic for diagnosis and they said URI. Kitten died due to their ineptitude.
My visit was good with my frenchies, I being coming here for over 6 years.
Thoughtful, compassionate care for a very sick pet. Appreciated Dr. Muhlbach's support!

Went for a regular check up for our large dog and had a great experience. Quick service. Friendly and welcoming.

Jason, we’re so glad to know you had a wonderful experience at Pure Paws Veterinary Care of Clinton Hill! Our team is dedicated to giving every pet the best care possible, and it means a lot to see that reflected in your review. Thank you for your support!

Very kind and very friendly staff and Vet. I was impressed with the care my nine year old
pup received. the visit was for a checkup, vax update, and nails clipped. And the vet called the next morning to see how she was doing. Recommend without reservation.
It was a good first time visit...feasible price. Leave early for parking.

I have two dogs under 10lbs and have seen a slew of different DVMs here at pure paws since 2020 as vets have come and go. Five years later, I feel obligated to leave a review for Dr. Torre Muhlbach.

You can tell she genuinely loves her job in the way she goes above and beyond for her patients and their humans. She’s fear free certified (not a req @ pure paws but always a plus) and doesn’t rush to exam. She prioritizes getting to know the dog by sitting on the floor to get at their level, give treats, ask about temperament, etc.

This was my second dental cleaning at pure paws, first time with Dr. Muhlbach and I refuse to let anyone else near my pets.

Dr. Muhlbach is extremely thoughtful, kind, thorough and patient. Out of all the DVMs we’ve seen throughout the years, (bond vet, heart of Brooklyn, blue pearl), her caliber of professionalism and care don’t even compare. Her communication is on point and I wish she would open a veterinary school to teach other vets! All animals and their owners deserve this type of treatment and veterinary experience.

Thank you Dr. Muhlbach; pure paws is lucky to have you on their team.
